changes.comment: fallback: tell served heights (blocks a source delivered) from claimed heights (its head endpoints) everywhere; the lag failover now compares the active source's claim with the other sources' claims, so a consumer slower than a healthy source no longer fails it over; new gauges `sqd_fallback_source_lag_blocks`, `sqd_fallback_source_served_height` and `sqd_fallback_source_claimed_height`
